neighbours.label: the history and politics of European integration (EEC, Common Market, Maastricht, member states joining), firing on the following words such as ' in', ' the' or a year's digit; the same frames about other regions stay quiet
fire: Greece became the tenth member of the European Community in 1981.
Under the Treaty of Rome, the Six created the Common Market.
Voters rejected the European constitution in France and the Netherlands.
De Gaulle twice vetoed British entry into the EEC during the 1960s.
Spain and Portugal joined the Community after long talks in Brussels.
The Single European Act of 1986 strengthened the Parliament in Strasbourg.
Danish voters first refused the Maastricht deal in a 1992 referendum.
Austria, Finland and Sweden entered the European Union in 1995.
quiet: Ghana became the first independent member of the Commonwealth in Africa in 1957.
Under the Treaty of Tordesillas, Spain and Portugal divided the New World.
Voters rejected the new constitution in Bolivia and Ecuador.
Nixon twice vetoed spending on the health bill during the 1970s.
Argentina and Uruguay joined Mercosur after long talks in Asunción.
The Civil Rights Act of 1964 strengthened the courts in Washington.
Canadian voters first refused the Charlottetown deal in a 1992 referendum.
Vietnam, Laos and Myanmar entered ASEAN in the 1990s.
